newsitem.title: USA: Saudi importer raises Catalytica stake.
newsitem.headline: Saudi importer raises Catalytica stake.

text.p: Saad Alissa, a Saudi Arabian importer and dealer of cars, and entities controlled by him raised their stake in Catalytica Inc to 1,151,519 common shares, or 5.96 percent of the total, Alissa said on Tuesday.
Previously the group held 720,219 shares, or 3.7 percent.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the Alissa group said it added a net 431,300 shares to its stake between December 17 and February 6. The deals included a gross purchase of 500,000 shares at $6.00 each in a private transaction on February 6.
